components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary studio CTA in Botanical Olive for confirming outfits and saving wardrobe items.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; background: var(--olive-primary, #52634B); color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 10px); padding: 13px 20px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--olive-dark, #3F4C39); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--olive-dark, #3F4C39); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary action button with Pure Atelier fill and Stone Hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { width: 100%; background: #FFFFFF; color: var(--text-main, #1D201C); border: 1px solid var(--bg-border, #E8E3D8); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 10px); padding: 12px 20px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle, #F3EFE8); border-color: var(--olive-primary, #52634B); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--olive-primary, #52634B); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Occasion Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped occasion and category filter chip with active Botanical Olive state.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid var(--bg-border, #E8E3D8); color: var(--text-main, #1D201C); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--olive-primary, #52634B); background: var(--bg-subtle, #F3EFE8); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--olive-primary, #52634B); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip--active { background: var(--olive-primary, #52634B); border-color: var(--olive-primary, #52634B); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip--active:hover { background: var(--olive-dark, #3F4C39); border-color: var(--olive-dark, #3F4C39); }

components.name: Garment Grid Card
components.description: Compact wardrobe card housing a Sandstone Tint 1:1 garment well and label footer.
components.html: Linen Overshirt•••
components.css: .ds-garment-card { width: 170px; background: var(--bg-card, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--bg-border, #E8E3D8); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 14px); padding: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-garment-card:hover { border-color: var(--olive-primary, #52634B); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); } .ds-garment-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--olive-primary, #52634B); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-garment-well { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: var(--bg-subtle, #F3EFE8); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 10px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-garment-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-main, #1D201C); }

components.name: Metadata Select Field
components.description: Structured selector row for garment category, fabric, or color swatch attributes.
components.css: .ds-input-select { width: 100%; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid var(--bg-border, #E8E3D8); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 10px); padding: 10px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-main, #1D201C); transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-select:hover, .ds-input-select:focus-visible { border-color: var(--olive-primary, #52634B); outline: none; } .ds-color-dot { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #52634B; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-field-val { flex: 1; text-align: left; }

components.name: Studio Bottom Navigation
components.description: Frosted Warm Linen bottom navigation bar with Botanical Olive active tab indicator.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { width: 100%; height: 64px; background: rgba(250, 249, 246, 0.96); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-top: 1px solid rgba(220, 214, 204, 0.75); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; padding: 6px 14px; box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(26, 31, 25, 0.04); } .ds-nav-tab { background: transparent; border: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; color: var(--text-muted, #7A8174); cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: var(--text-main, #1D201C); background: rgba(82, 99, 75, 0.05); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--olive-primary, #52634B); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-tab--active { color: var(--olive-primary, #52634B); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
Woobi pairs the calm warmth of a daylight dressing room with the spatial clarity of an interactive 3D wardrobe studio. Surfaces stay intentionally quiet—warm alabaster linen, raw stone hairlines, and crisp cotton cards—so garments, fabric swatches, and the 3D mannequin always command visual focus without competing chrome.

On the web studio (and its synced WebView surface), depth is expressed through tonal layering and whispered ambient lift rather than heavy drop shadows. For native Android surfaces, Material Design 3 governs structural navigation and ergonomics, adopting Android Dynamic Color (Material You) as the primary scheme on Android 12+ while anchoring the static fallback and brand identity in Woobi's Botanical Olive and Warm Linen palette.
keyCharacteristics: Warm organic light-canvas surfaces (#FAF9F6, #F8F7F4, #F3EFE8) that let garment photography and 3D materials read accurately.
Botanical Olive (#52634B) reserved for primary actions, active navigation states, and selected filter pills.
High-contrast editorial serif headlines paired with crisp, legible sans-serif UI controls and metadata.
Android-ready ergonomics: Material You primary theming with Woobi Olive fallback, 48x48 dp minimum native touch targets, and edge-to-edge safe-area awareness.

rules.name: The Quiet Backdrop Rule
rules.body: Saturated color belongs on garments and the primary olive CTA—never on whole-screen backgrounds. Keep >=85% of every screen in warm linen, sandstone, and pure white surfaces.

rules.name: The Android Dynamic Fallback Rule
rules.body: Native Android screens adopt Material You dynamic color schemes on Android 12+ while mapping Woobi's Botanical Olive (#52634B) and Warm Linen (#FAF9F6) directly into the static Material 3 color scheme fallback.

rules.name: The Serif-Anchor Rule
rules.body: Reserve serif faces for display titles and editorial brand marks; never set dense form fields, garment tags, or bottom-bar tabs in serif.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and border-defined at rest; reserve lift (translateY(-1px) and hover shadows) for active pointer feedback or top-level floating chrome.

dos: Do keep >=85% of screen area in warm linen, sandstone, and white surfaces so garment colors and 3D renders stay color-accurate.
Do enforce >=48x48 dp native Android touch targets and >=4.5:1 WCAG AA text contrast (darkening #7A8174 / #8C7B68 muted text on cream backgrounds where needed).
Do use exponential deceleration easing (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for panels and tab transitions.
donts: Don't use elastic/bounce cubic-bezier curves (>1.0 overshoot) on drawers, cards, or modals.
Don't render tiny micro-text (<12px) for interactive labels, taglines, or metadata on mobile/Android screens.
Don't ship default Material template purple (#6650A4 / #D0BCFF) as Woobi's fallback theme in android-app—use Material You dynamic color with Botanical Olive + Warm Linen static fallback.
